name: mini-calendar
title: Mini Calendar
description: A compact horizontal strip of seven stacked month-and-day buttons between previous and next arrows. Clicking a day marks it and lists that day's events in a panel underneath.
use: A page needs a narrow date selector with the selected day's schedule right beside it.
avoid: It only pages through whole weeks and has no month grid, so reaching a distant date takes repeated clicks.
a11y: The chevron arrows are icon-only with no label, so screen readers announce them as unlabelled buttons. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A short rounded bordered strip holding a left chevron, seven narrow day cells with a tiny grey month above a bold number, and a right chevron on black. The selected day is a white pill, today a grey one; a bordered card below lists times and event titles.
behaves: The arrows shift the window a whole week at a time. Hovering a day tints it grey and clicking it fills it white, while the panel below swaps to that date's heading and its list of events.
customise: Set the number of days, the starting date and the selected date through props, and compose the arrows, day cells and any agenda yourself; styling comes in as classes.
weight: light: Seven plain buttons and two chevrons; date-fns only computes the day labels.
